dogecoin.text: @cb_doge Elon Musk praises Dogecoin, calling it “fundamentally better than anything else” he’s encountered.

@cb_doge Dogecoin has gained a lot of traction as a fun and community-driven cryptocurrency, but whether it becomes a widely accepted form of money is still up for debate. Its popularity and value continue to fluctuate, making it an interesting part of the crypto world.
@dogecoin_empire Agreed! Let’s all strive to make thoughtful, informed choices. It’s about learning and growing every day.
